emotional_tone: Warm, caring, respectful, intuitive, highly accessible.

typography.anti_default_rule: No Inter. Use warm, highly legible geometric or rounded sans-serifs.

scale.label: text-lg font-bold tracking-wide uppercase
scale.minimum_size: 20px (Strict rule: No text smaller than 20px anywhere in the app)

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 64px height (h-16) and width for all interactive elements. No exceptions.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-6 sm:p-8 for generous breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.layout_strategy: Strictly linear (1-column). Avoid complex grids or overlapping elements. Every action must have a clear, distinct row.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for a soft, friendly, non-clinical feel.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: shadow-lg shadow-black/5 (soft ambient shadows, no harsh lines).

buttons.primary: bg-[#2D5A4C] text-white h-16 rounded-2xl text-2xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-3 active:scale-95 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F3EFE6] text-[#1A2E26] h-16 rounded-2xl text-2xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-3 active:scale-95 transition-transform border-2 border-[#E2DCD0]
buttons.sos: bg-[#D93829] text-white h-20 rounded-full text-3xl font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-4 shadow-xl active:bg-[#B32B1E]

cards.default: bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl border-2 border-[#E2DCD0] shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-4
cards.interactive: bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl border-2 border-[#E2DCD0] shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-4 active:border-[#2D5A4C] active:bg-[#E6EFEA]

inputs.default: h-16 bg-white border-2 border-[#E2DCD0] rounded-2xl px-6 text-2xl text-[#1A2E26] placeholder:text-[#4A6157] focus:border-[#2D5A4C] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#2D5A4C]/20

onboarding.description: Personalized profile setup. Large inputs for Name, how they want to be called (e.g., 'Seu Antônio'), and photo capture.
onboarding.visuals: Use 'onboarding_illustration' to set a warm tone.

home_dashboard.description: Greeting area: 'Bom dia, Seu Antônio ☀️' + Large Avatar. Core actions: 'Medicamentos de Hoje', 'Meus Compromissos', 'Jogos', 'Área da Família'.
home_dashboard.layout: Vertical list of massive cards. Sticky SOS button at the bottom right or centered bottom bar.

medicine_tracker.description: AI-powered medicine identification. Big button 'Identificar Remédio por Foto'. Fallback to manual entry with big text.
medicine_tracker.interaction: Visual display of the pill (color/shape) + Caregiver audio snippet ('Pai, hora do remédio da pressão').

alarms_reminders.description: Humanized reminders combining large text and a play button for Caregiver Audio/Video.
alarms_reminders.tts: Fallback to native device TTS reading the text aloud if no custom audio is recorded.

cognitive_games.description: Simple cognitive exercises: Memory (cards), Logical Sequence, Questions.
cognitive_games.ui_rules: Extreme contrast. Massive tap areas. Positive reinforcement ('Muito bem, Vovó Maria!').

family_area.description: A digital scrapbook and message center. Family members can leave audio/video notes.
family_area.visuals: Use 'family_illustration' as an empty state or header.

onboarding_illustration.description: Warm onboarding illustration of elderly using app

family_illustration.description: Illustration of family hugging, for family area

accessibility_and_ux_rules.contrast: All text MUST pass WCAG AAA (Contrast ratio > 7:1) due to age-related vision changes. Do not use light gray text.
accessibility_and_ux_rules.iconography: All icons must be accompanied by text labels. Do not rely on icons alone.
accessibility_and_ux_rules.audio: Implement large 'Ouvir' (Listen) buttons next to all major text blocks to trigger TTS or caregiver audio.
accessibility_and_ux_rules.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST have semantic `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='sos-emergency-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as an Expo React Native Web compatible app (mobile_web_app).
Ensure all text scales dynamically and uses the minimum 20px size rule as defined.
Use Lucide-React icons (e.g., Phone, Pill, Calendar, Heart, Brain) but scale them to massive sizes (min size 32).
For the SOS Button, ensure it is always accessible (fixed position or highly visible in the nav/header).
Use standard HTML audio/video elements or Expo Audio for the caregiver playback feature (mocked if necessary).
Mock the AI Medicine Identification by showing a fake camera view that resolves to a mocked recognized medicine (e.g., 'Losartana 50mg').
Ensure all UI is strictly in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
